verdict.rationale: As a programmatic API, Gemini is headless by design. The docs show REST access with an API key, official SDKs for Python, JS/TS, Go and Java, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, an asynchronous Batch API for bulk jobs, and background execution, all of which can be scripted in CI pipelines. Community reports of low Tier 1 request caps and tier warm-up requirements limit large automated workloads but do not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation guidance (e.g. secrets handling, non-interactive auth patterns), a first-party CLI, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and rate-limit headroom for automation without tier ramp-up.
